property_summary: For any caller sending exactly 10 ether to C's fallback at a strictly later timestamp, the reference contract only forwards its entire balance to the caller when block.number % 15 == 0 (so address(c).balance == 0 after the call iff block.number % 15 == 0); the mutant inverts the condition and will instead forward when block.number % 15 != 0, violating this rule for some block numbers.
change_summary: Change the transfer condition to trigger on block.number % 15 != 0, altering when balance is sent and thus observable state after fallback.
